headline: DR Congo Residents Sue Miner COMMUS Over Pollution
summary: Twenty-seven Kolwezi residents filed a lawsuit against miner COMMUS and the Congolese state over alleged pollution, with a first hearing held on November 3.
why: Environmental litigation involving mining operations in resource-rich developing nations can introduce regulatory risks, legal liabilities, and operational disruptions for mining firms.

impacts.name: COMMUS
impacts.why: The lawsuit names COMMUS as a defendant over environmental pollution allegations.
